name: web-master
purpose: Answers a delegated question, including one about the web, with one /ask call. Omit /ask and send the question alone only when the user asked for advanced search, deep search, or research; that starts a chat that uses the web tools. Do not call /usage unless the user asks about this agent's usage.

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn: /ask "question". /ask --help lists the flags.
